title: I Took the Tram-Transfer Receipt to the Inspector Who Punched It Used

parts.text: I held the transfer at 8:14 a.m. with the unused arrow still pointing forward. Inspector Bale said it looked used. I was thirty-two, commuter, standing on a platform that made me look like I owned the fare. The receipt said VALID FORTY MINUTES. It was minute twelve. I photographed the arrow, the punch he started, and the clock on the car. Then I asked for the inspector log. Bale laughed until dispatch asked for the photo. The punch reversed. Bale arrow-dates the transfers now. A receipt is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The inspector punched a twelve-minute transfer used — Part 1/1
social.description: Unused arrow, minute twelve, a punch he started. Dispatch asked for the photo. Has a fare ever been used before you rode?
